decision: Trusted multiprocessing spawn may import frozen native_tensor_comparison and Torch CPU library code while unpickling the actual supervisor-owned ScratchBudget before entering run_case. This is not a child pre-Torch allocation guard.
hard_blockers: Exact outer supervisor/context/plan/admission transcript schema and reviewed implementation absent.
New native CPU QA and source/accounting/partial-write/phase evidence absent.
No GPU job, real-model validation, training or pilot admitted.
mandatory_child_before_cuda_or_model_wor: Revalidate source, actual current allocation/environment/deadline and inherited parent/spawn/snapshot identity immediately.
Require torch.cuda.is_initialized()==False before any CUDA query/initialization, model/tokenizer/data operation or diagnostic tensor construction.

No child ScratchBudget constructor, counter reset or ad hoc field restoration. Trusted spawn transfers the actual simple object fields, with cumulative bytes and later parent reconciliation unchanged.
mandatory_parent_before_class_import_or_: Actual assigned compute allocation/source/environment/deadline/current-job and one-use stage context verified.
No local/login-node model, tokenizer, data, tests or tensor work. ScratchBudget instantiated exactly once on actual compute with160GiB initial free check.
Trusted source-bound spawn target, parent PID and nonce, immutable budget/source/current-job snapshot and exact VALUE digest bound to guarded context. No untrusted pickle files.
proof_limits: The trusted source-bound fresh spawn lifecycle establishes intended pre-entry behavior; there is no claim of a general runtime enumeration proving that arbitrary Python code allocated no CPU tensors. Source, provenance and immediate uninitialized-CUDA checks remain distinct.
